project.name: Ballindean

properties.sourceDataset: Current named-place record and strict editorial study area

project.boundarySource: Current named-place location corroborated by the Gazetteer of British Place Names. This compact editorial study area is not a legal settlement boundary and excludes Inchture and surrounding estates.
project.researchNotes: Completed identity, heritage, council-core-path, food, facilities and dog-access screen on 2026-09-03. Ballindean Steading is listed but partly converted to residences, and Ballindean House’s activity venue is not presented as a general visitor attraction. No independent daytime food provider, public toilet, public visitor parking or eligible trail card was evidenced within the strict study area.

touristAppeal.label: Minor Interest
touristAppeal.summary: Ballindean is a legitimate Carse of Gowrie hamlet with a council-recorded core-path circuit, but no independently managed visitor attraction or practical visitor facility was verified.
touristAppeal.dogAccessSummary: The council path crosses rural land: use responsible control under the Scottish Outdoor Access Code, particularly around livestock. No dog-focused visitor facility was verified.

townGuide.intro: Ballindean has a documented rural identity and council core-path connection, but the guide does not promote private residences, estate land or unverified facilities as visitor provision.
